name: latticore
description: Self-hosted panel for Minecraft servers and proxy networks

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w packages/shared" "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w packages/shared && npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
